verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe shows the phaser npm package is MIT-licensed, and the engine is published in the public phaserjs/phaser GitHub repository. Together these mean developers can read, fork and modify the full engine source. missing for 10: first-party docs on building or patching the engine from source, explicit statement that the full engine source lives in the repo, independent hands-on reports of modifying engine internals.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall

citations.quote: You can use JavaScript or TypeScript for development.
